channel.description: Verbose for Mac: tagged releases, plus beta builds of main.

item.title: Verbose beta 238
item.description:
Fewer places to look, nothing lost

Mac

  • Dictation shows in the Ribbon or the notch. The floating button is gone. If you used the floating button, dictation shows in the Ribbon instead. Change it in Settings › Ribbon and notch.
  • The thought bubble starts off on a new install. Turn it on in Settings › Features › Thoughts or from the menu bar. If you had it on, it stays on.
  • Plan my day is the one plan maker. Make a plan merged into it. A kind that ran Make a plan runs Plan my day. Results it made stay on their transcripts, and Run again makes a Plan my day in their place.
  • Journal entry merged into Daily reflection. A kind that ran Journal entry runs Daily reflection. Entries it wrote stay on their transcripts.
  • The Key points template is gone. The automatic summary lists key points. Key points results stay on their transcripts. A kind that ran it turns Off.
  • Templates holds your text actions too, each marked with where it works. The actions that ran on selected text from Settings › Actions are in Templates, marked Selected text and recordings. Edit, add, and reorder them there.
  • Moments became the Library's Marked filter. Marked lists every recording with a bookmark, a mark, or a note at a time. If Moments was one of your iPhone tabs, Library or Thoughts takes its place.
  • Links became the Library's Links filter, and the sidebar's Links row is gone.
  • The sidebar shows Queue only while something is queued or transcribing.
  • Home has six sections: Record, tiles, This week, Recent, Thoughts, and Journal. Queue, Projects, Moments, Last dictation, and Stats left Home. The sidebar, the Library, Dictations, and You keep what they showed.
  • New installs start with New thought in place of the Live captions tile. Live captions stays in Edit Home, the menus, and its shortcut. If you never changed your tiles, you keep the ones you had.
  • Home's tiles drop Search, Moments, Queue, and Paste a link. Import takes a file or a link. Search with ⌘K on the Mac, or in the Library.
  • The Ribbon and the menu bar no longer list dictations. The menu bar opens Dictations. Your dictations are in Dictations, and Recall (⌥⌘V) brings back recent ones.
  • ⌘F opens the same search as ⌘K. Find in Transcripts opens Search or ask on Search. The Library's field still filters the Library.
  • ⌘O opens Import, which takes files, a folder, or a link. ⌘N opens it too.
  • Today's page has a note mode, Write or dictate, in place of the Brain dump window. Choose File › Today's Note. Hold ⌃⌥ and talk, or type, then Plan my day. Notes from the Brain dump window are on their day's page.
  • Record as shows five rows: Voice note, Meeting, Thought, Brain dump, and Audio only. Turn Interview, Journal entry, or Talk back on with Edit Record as. If you recorded one in the last 30 days, it stays.
  • Journal shows in By day once you have an entry or turn on Journal entry. On iPhone, Journal is offered as a tab under the same rule.
  • Ask hides recipes until you turn on Recipes. Recipes you have keep running. Turn them on in Ask's More menu, or on iPhone in Settings › Features › Templates.

Also on iPhone

  • Keyboard settings suggest the keyboard and the Action button to start a session.
